notes.title: Raybeem v1.1.0 Update - New Space Theme
notes.content:
Hello Raybeem Fans!

It's been a while coming but the version 1.1.0 update is finally live on Steam.

The major new addition is a new space theme called "StarStream." This new theme includes a mecha themed mini-game, where you can fly around and shoot at robots that pop-up around you in all directions. Please give it a shot and let me know what you think!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/1a40aba6ff189349b0b3be1fb845c0eb26078191.gif[/img] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/8e587d37a2a3b9bf3a8e20cbe6ab167096b58d2e.gif[/img]

Here's a video running through the new Theme:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QuNxP6tTM4g

[b]Other additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] New "VR Theme Shortcut" setting in "Settings." Enable this to use the controller shortcut for switching themes (hold trigger+grip and move left/right on thumbstick)
[*] New "VR Menu Display" setting in "Settings." This disables the VR menu in case you're using Raybeem for a "demo" environment.
[*] Fixed some VR menu bugs. 
[/list]

[b]Raybeem Events:[/b]
We've been exhibiting Raybeem around Los Angeles at art shows and mini-raves.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/8673eddb7e69c0c648749b3360dbf87d5c5de570.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/6508507afaf67778503eb669f61eb4fa1a9f26b2.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/917bb62300137133f98e58187e9f3923eaebe4ec.png[/img]

Our shows have been kind of sporadic so please follow us on Twitter (https://twitter.com/sonofbryce) and Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/raybeemvr/).

Join our mailing list at: http://sokay.us2.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=d44ff735a747946cc05d322d8&id=dbae4297c8

If you like what we're doing, support Sokay on Patreon: http://www.patreon.com/sokay/

Stay Tuned for further updates!

Peace!

-Bryson

notes.title: Raybeem Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Raybeem fans![/b]

Thanks for your support during our first week of launch. We're excited to finally bring Raybeem to The World. This is only the beginning and we're aiming to bring new content in updates. If there's something you want to see in Raybeem, be sure to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/631120/discussions/]let us know in the forums[/url]. 

[h1]Events:[/h1]

We've been exhibiting Raybeem at different art shows and parties around Los Angeles. In a live setting, Raybeem reacts to the music of the DJ. If you're interesting in having Raybeem at your event, hit us up!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29109830/95079ca2c764fada957ef0637724295f7d0d43e9.jpg[/img]

Last sec notice, but we're having an event tonight in Los Angeles. We're exhibiting at:

[b]NEXT LEVEL One Love Pre-Party[/b]

Saturday, Oct 7 at 9 PM - 4 AM

Fais Do Do
5257 W Adams Blvd, Los Angeles, California 90016

Info at: https://www.facebook.com/events/1864276350531207/1874968596128649/

[h1]Updates:[/h1]

We just patched Raybeem with a v1.0.1 release, fixing some issues we found relating to VR detection in both the Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.

If you find any issues, please drop a line in the Raybeem forum (http://steamcommunity.com/app/631120/discussions).
